areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Macro-drainage system reduces flooding and related environmental damage, raising urban resilience to climate change.

areas.name: Energy efficiency and renewable energy
areas.reason: Photovoltaic plant to supply public buildings, saving public funds and giving energy security.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: New sewerage system (network, pumping, treatment, household connections) to raise municipal coverage.

areas.name: Biodiversity and forest resources
areas.reason: Public green space promoting biome conservation, including mangrove, with environmental awareness and education.

areas.name: Individual entrepreneurs and micro/small firms
areas.reason: Tourism and culture centre provides spaces for craft and local products typically sold by micro and small entrepreneurs.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: Construction of new schools, in rural and dense urban areas, expanding education capacity.
